WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS overall_avg_rate
  FROM film
)
SELECT 
  rs.rating,
  rs.avg_replacement_cost,
  rs.avg_per_day_rate,
  rs.avg_per_day_rate - oa.overall_avg_rate AS above_average_amount
FROM rating_stats rs
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE rs.avg_per_day_rate > oa.overall_avg_rate
ORDER BY rs.rating
